title: •Weather Vane
caption: •Weather Vane (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Character here lost if new character arrives. Opponent activates no Force at your cloud sectors. During owner’s control phase, they must relocate character here to an unoccupied Cloud City site (place in Used Pile otherwise). {alter}
lore: The metal rods extending from the bottom of Cloud City are part of the city’s flotation system. Sensors detect the velocity of wind and the content of local clouds.
copyright: TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Light Side Weather Vane (the Dark Side one is slip 49). Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Curly apostrophe in owner’s; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter} (stub expands 'Immune to Alter'). Slip text otherwise matches the stub (stub page is 'Weather Vane (V) (Light) (Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds)'). Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in city’s (wiki straight). Base page 'Weather Vane' = the Light card (hatnote points to 'Weather Vane (Dark)' for the DS one). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line '…1997 DECIPHER INC.' just legible. Modern: V19-L-weathervane.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 19 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
